contract.pentagons: Three regular planar pentagons with common center and unit radius; C fixed at 18°. IDs P-A/P-B/P-C are local layer labels, not new canonical faces.

motion.phase: 0..360°; central H3 orientation and magenta marker use the same φ
motion.classification: Owner-proposed constructed view rule, not derived from image measurements or numeric markers

contract.geometry: CCW convex half-plane clipping computes A∩B, A\B and B\A. At φ=0 the differences have five components each and the intersection ten vertices. Counts are recomputed, not fixed; aligned poses have zero difference and five intersection vertices.
contract.negativeSpace: SVG mask: disk of radius 1.12 minus the union of visible pentagons. This is bounded 2D negative space, not black 3D pyramids or a packing proof.
contract.dodeca: Unchanged existing H3 geometry factory supplies original 20 vertices, 30 edges, 12 face IDs/index lists. A uniform 0.65/maxRadius display scale and rigid rotations are applied; no native 60-cell controller commands.
contract.lenses: Two elliptic clipping windows of the same scene: centers (−.35,0),(+.35,0), radii (.82,.68). No refraction or physical light model.
contract.curve: Declared planar reference x=1.12 sin(t), y=.43 sin(2t); not a literal Möbius band.
contract.colours: Source palette A red, B green, C violet; alternative palette red/blue/yellow. Uses existing arithmetic greyshift display transform; no geometric equality inferred.
contract.history: Third independent overlay stream stack, latest 64 visited snapshots; record/pause/clear/export use existing overlay mechanisms. Existing book and 5B histories stay separate.
contract.playback: One scene interval, 40ms per 2° phase step, explicitly started by owner. Stops at 360° unless Repeat enabled. Manual phase/mode or hidden tab pauses. Host interlocks pause Q4/5B/Master before scene play; source selection away from stack pauses scene. Q4/5B/Master play pauses scene.
contract.return: Geometry at φ=360 equals φ=0 within exact normalized-angle construction. This is pose Return only, never native source Return.
contract.export: Overlay JSON retains full constructed scene per recorded frame; global integration snapshot adds layeredScene state and stack history.
